NYU OUD Evidence Map Archived Version

This is an archived version of the NYU Opioid Use Disorder Evidence map, produced in 2022. The aim was to create and publish a summative and interactive representation of all peer-reviewed interventional and observational trials of OUD treatments and common clinical outcomes.

While we are in the process of migrating the data to a Wiki-style format, this interactive data table, dashboard, and evidence map allows the user to explore, slice, download, and build on our data.
